bossNana.heroLead: Boss Narra is a grounded AI advisor for MSMEs, designed to explain financing options, marketing strategy, and government filing steps with local business context and trusted source links.
bossNana.msg1: I can help you compare financing options, understand DTI filing steps, and plan your next marketing move.
bossNana.msg2: We need a clearer payback plan for our cash flow.
bossNana.msg3: Let’s review cash cycle timing, debt exposure, and compliance gaps, then map this to a next-step action list.
bossNana.moduleSubhead: Each module connects operational decisions to good recordkeeping, official references, and local business context.

finance.title: Your finance checkup
finance.intro: Enter monthly business totals and current balances. Boss Narra will prepare estimates from your inputs; this is not tax, lending, or investment advice.
finance.behind: I may have missed a filing
finance.notRegistered: I am not registered with BIR yet
finance.consent: I agree to store these financial figures in my Enterseed account so I can return to this assessment. I can delete them later.
finance.consentRequired: Consent is required to save this assessment.
finance.amountInvalid: Amounts must be whole pesos from 0 to ₱1,000,000,000.
finance.empty: Complete and save the assessment to see personalized estimates.
finance.error: We could not load or save your assessment. Please try again.
finance.taxDisclaimer: Tax standing is self-reported. Verify forms and deadlines directly with BIR or a qualified tax professional.
finance.estimateDisclaimer: These are user-input-based planning estimates, not audited statements, professional advice, or a government assessment.
finance.emptyCash: Enter your figures to get a cash-management estimate.
finance.positiveCash: Monthly operating surplus is positive. Keep a cash reserve for slow sales and upcoming obligations.
finance.negativeCash: Expenses exceed income in this estimate. Review discretionary costs and cash timing before taking on new commitments.
finance.lowBuffer: Your reported cash covers less than one month of operating expenses and debt payments. Prioritize a cash plan before expansion.
finance.reserve: Your reported cash is approximately {months} months of operating expenses and debt payments. Keep an accessible reserve.
finance.noDebt: No outstanding debt was entered. Keep records of any future borrowing and repayment terms.
finance.highDebt: Monthly debt payments are high compared with estimated operating profit. Review due dates and terms; discuss options with your lender before changing payments.
finance.debtReview: Compare scheduled debt payments with your monthly operating surplus and keep a dated repayment record.
finance.taxCurrent: You report that filings are current. Keep receipts and filing confirmations; verify upcoming obligations with BIR.
finance.taxDue: You report a filing is coming due. Confirm the applicable form, period, and deadline through BIR eServices or your tax professional.
finance.taxBehind: You may have a missed filing. Contact BIR or a qualified tax professional promptly to confirm the correct next step; do not rely on this estimate for penalties or deadlines.
finance.taxNotRegistered: You report that you are not registered with BIR. Verify the registration steps that apply to your business directly with BIR.
finance.investmentReady: The estimates show a positive operating surplus and at least three months of cash coverage. Prepare a written use-of-funds and downside plan before considering investment.
finance.investmentWait: Build a steadier operating surplus and cash reserve before committing to expansion or new investment. This is a planning prompt, not investment advice.
finance.financialReports: Use estimated operating profit and the balance summary below as a draft practice set. Reconcile against source documents before sharing or filing.
finance.reportCashFlow: Cash flow after reported debt payment
finance.cashFlowAfterDebt: Estimated operating cash after debt payment
finance.accountPrivacy: Financial inputs are private to your account and used only to show this planning estimate. This prototype does not encrypt SQLite data at rest.

chatbot.name: Boss Narra
chatbot.label: Ask Boss Narra
chatbot.placeholder: Ask about finance, marketing, or official business resources…
chatbot.welcome: Hi, I’m Boss Narra. I can help organize next steps, but I won’t guess at legal, tax, loan, or government requirements. I’ll share official verification links when relevant.
chatbot.disclaimer: Informational support only. Always verify rules directly with DTI, DOST, your LGU, or BIR.
chatbot.unavailable: Boss Narra could not reach the service. Please try again.

auth.headline: Grow smarter with Enterseed and Boss Narra.
auth.lead: Cash flow checkups, local suppliers across South Cotabato, and an independent AI advisor that links to official verification portals.
auth.registerLead: Free for MSMEs in South Cotabato and SOCCSKSARGEN.
auth.agree: I agree to the terms of service and to Enterseed storing my financial figures for workspace tools.
auth.agreeRequired: Agree to the terms to create your account.
auth.signInFailed: Sign-in failed. Check your email and password.
auth.demoNote: Opens a sample Koronadal business profile.

guidance.All_fixed_costs_are_for_the_whole_batch_: All fixed costs are for the whole batch. Percentage fees apply to selling revenue. Margin is profit divided by selling price; markup is profit divided by cost. Taxes are included only if you enter them in costs.
guidance.Check_potential_support_against_the_prov: Check potential support against the provider’s current requirements.
guidance.Check_the_provider_s_official_page__loca: Check the provider’s official page, location coverage and requirements. A potential match does not guarantee eligibility or approval. Save an opportunity and add a reminder only when you have a confirmed date.
guidance.Check_whether_your_selling_price_covers_: Check whether your selling price covers your costs.
guidance.Choose_one_customer_group_and_one_clear_: Choose one customer group and one clear offer. Explain the benefit and how to contact your business. Review generated drafts before publishing and track which messages lead to inquiries.
guidance.Choose_your_current_business_goal__Your_: Choose your current business goal. Your plan suggests three practical steps using clear rules. Open a tool, do the work, and then update the action status. You can hide suggestions and revisit completed history.
guidance.Compare_the_same_product_specifications_: Compare the same product specifications and units. Ask about minimum orders, delivery, lead times and payment terms. A cheaper quote may require more stock or earlier payment.
guidance.Compare_total_costs__lead_times_and_paym: Compare total costs, lead times and payment terms.
guidance.Compare_user_entered_quotations__Prices_: Compare user-entered quotations. Prices and terms have not been independently verified.
guidance.Complete_valid_inputs_to_see_your_estima: Complete valid inputs to see your estimate. Margin plus percentage fees must be below 100%.
guidance.Could_not_save__Check_your_entries_and_t: Could not save. Check your entries and try again.
guidance.Counts_reflect_recorded_actions__not_pag: Counts reflect recorded actions, not page views. Staff accounts are excluded from business activity metrics.
guidance.Describe_your_customers__operations_and_: Describe your customers, operations and funding needs.
guidance.Edit_your_goals_at_any_time__Completed_a: Edit your goals at any time. Completed action history is kept.
guidance.Estimates_assume_all_produced_units_sell: Estimates assume all produced units sell. Displayed amounts are rounded; calculations retain precision.
guidance.Include_materials__labor__packaging_and_: Include materials, labor, packaging and delivery. Divide batch costs by usable units. Account for selling fees before setting a target margin. Check whether customers will pay the resulting price.
guidance.Internal_note___visible_only_to_staff: Internal note — visible only to staff
guidance.Keep_your_questions__responses_and_next_: Keep your questions, responses and next steps together.
guidance.No_reminders_yet__Create_your_first_busi: No reminders yet. Create your first business reminder above.
guidance.No_reviewed_opportunities_match_your_fil: No reviewed opportunities match your filters. Staff will publish entries after reviewing official sources.
guidance.Order_quantity_is_the_greater_of_your_re: Order quantity is the greater of your requirement and the minimum order. Compare equivalent products and units. The lowest price is not automatically the best fit.
guidance.Organize_your_information_and_confirm_re: Organize your information and confirm requirements with the relevant agency.
guidance.Plan_prices_using_your_own_costs__Result: Plan prices using your own costs. Results are estimates, not guaranteed profits.
guidance.Potential_match_for_your_business_stage_: Potential match for your business stage. Confirm all requirements.
guidance.Potential_matches_are_not_confirmation_o: Potential matches are not confirmation of eligibility. Check the official source before applying.
guidance.Price___unit_cost____1___target_markup__: Price = unit cost × (1 + target markup) ÷ (1 − selling fee rate).
guidance.Price___unit_cost____1___selling_fee_rat: Price = unit cost ÷ (1 − selling fee rate − target margin).
guidance.Record_cash_received_and_cash_paid_separ: Record cash received and cash paid separately. Review upcoming payments before spending available cash. Keep personal and business transactions separate. Update your finance records each week.
guidance.Record_confirmed_dates_and_plan_your_nex: Record confirmed dates and plan your next follow-ups.
guidance.Response_time_uses_elapsed_hours_across_: Response time uses elapsed hours across all responded requests, including weekends. Unanswered requests are excluded.
guidance.Save_your_profile_to_see_your_three_reco: Save your profile to see your three recommended actions.
guidance.Small_lessons_you_can_put_into_practice_: Small lessons you can put into practice today.
guidance.Tell_us_your_goals_and_choose_your_next_: Tell us your goals and choose your next steps.
guidance.These_features_save_to_a_real_account__S: These features save to a real account. Sign out of demo mode and sign in to use them.
guidance.Turn_your_offer_into_a_draft_for_your_cu: Turn your offer into a draft for your customers.
guidance.Unable_to_load_your_records__Please_retr: Unable to load your records. Please retry.
guidance.Use_current_sales_and_expenses_to_unders: Use current sales and expenses to understand your cash position.
guidance.Window__rolling_seven_days__Useful_actio: Window: rolling seven days. Useful actions: completing a recommendation or first saving a costing or comparison. Active: at least one recorded event. Repeat: events on two or more Manila dates.
guidance.Write_down_what_you_sell__who_needs_it_a: Write down what you sell, who needs it and how you will deliver it. Test your idea with potential customers before making large purchases. Confirm registration requirements directly with DTI, your LGU and the relevant agencies.
guidance.Your_business_details_turn_into_three_pr: Your business details turn into three practical next steps.
guidance.Your_dates_and_follow_ups__in_Asia_Manil: Your dates and follow-ups, in Asia/Manila. Confirm official deadlines with the relevant agency.
